notes.title: Patch Notes from Space Armada
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304275/8715d5900b0b7f45f586b5c536613997f1ddeada.png

Happy galactic autumn, HRO cadets! 

Today we're pushing a small update with a few fixes and various improvements:


 small tweaks to music in Episode 03
 adjustments to audio mix
 content edits and logic adjustments to character conversations


As always, thanks so much for playing HRO! Be sure to enjoy the climate simulator and see some of those colorful leaves before winter arrives.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304275/2fc0ce7caf72c15c11f2635bd0762f4a29af82f2.png

notes.title: Patch Notes from Rapturia Prime
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304275/8715d5900b0b7f45f586b5c536613997f1ddeada.png

Hello, SpaceArmada HROs! 

Today we're pushing a patch with a few iterations and fixes for various improvements:


 iterations on underscoring in various cutscenes
 replaced musical stingers in gameplay
 fixed a bug whereby the game would save without naming the file
 improvements in the ACCESS panel when hacking various ship systems
 adjustments to core audio settings


As always, thanks so much for playing HRO! Be sure to take your R&R leave. It doesn't roll over to the next space-time year, you know!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304275/2fc0ce7caf72c15c11f2635bd0762f4a29af82f2.png

notes.title: HRO Livestream with therenesance
notes.content:
It's the last day of Steam Next Fest, and the multitalented renesance will be livestreaming the Demo Episode of HRO: Adventures of a Humanoid Resources Officer tonight, June 22nd at 8:30pm EST!

Come say hello and experience an introduction to the world of HRO with his wonderful community! 

The Livestream will not be streamed directly to the Steam store. To join the livestream on Twitch click here: TheRenesance


About therenesance:
A simple man with a simple passion for retro video games, among many other things. He streams multiple times a week playing NES, SNES, PC, SMS, Genesis, etc and also does Saturday night painting sessions. In fact, you should check out his video game inspired art on his website here: www.gamescapeartist.com
